question: Do Hebrew MT lemma tokens and the V10 glyph operators exhibit cross-corpus-stable matches in an alphabet-free state-transition fingerprint space?
claimBoundary: A pass supports transferable similarity of anonymous structural transition fingerprints. It does not establish translation, common historical origin, theological identity, phonetic equivalence, causal mechanism, or machine execution.

hebrewSource.tokenIdentity: first numeric lemma component rendered H<number>; no gloss, morphology, translation, Strong definition, verse label, or semantic annotation is used by induction or evaluation

projector.segment: Hebrew verse or glyph line; transitions never cross segment boundaries
projector.incomingState: first-occurrence canonical equality pattern of the four preceding operator identities, left padded with START; current operator identity is excluded
projector.outcomePrecedence: SAME_CURRENT, then nearest H1..H4, then SEEN_EARLIER_SEGMENT, then NEW_SEGMENT; END at segment end

training.pairSelection: mutual nearest neighbor by weighted cosine similarity, train only

evaluation.primaryMetric: mean weighted cosine similarity of frozen train-paired operators in the evaluation lane
evaluation.rankMetric: median percentile rank of the frozen glyph among frozen glyph candidates for each Hebrew operator
evaluation.fullAdjudication: both holdout and control must independently pass every lane gate; evaluation lanes were opened in earlier V10-V14 work, so a pass is mechanistic cross-corpus evidence, not fresh independent confirmation
